newsitem.title: UK: Brendan Foster seeks stock market listing for Nova.
newsitem.headline: Brendan Foster seeks stock market listing for Nova.

text.p: Brendan Foster, the long distance runner and television commentator, said he plans to float shares in his sportswear and event marketing company, Nova International on the London Stock Exchange.
On flotation, the company will be renamed View From International Plc.
The flotation is expected to raise about four million stg, net of expenses, through an institutional placing and public offering.
The proceeds will be used for the development and marketing for its sports wear brand, and to provide capital for the general requirements of the company.
The market capitalisation post flotation is expected to be between 10 million and 12 million stg.
Shaw & Co Limited and Mees Pierson Securities Limited are advisors and brokers to the issue. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
